notes: step_gpu = plan + GDN + attention (H3's ours engine path) + head, from per-layer graph timings
staged = measured wall-clock round trip incl. index readback and syncs; zero-copy = measured in-graph GPU gather from pinned host memory
prefetch / lag1 overlap: copy hidden behind compute up to the window; the copy and the GDN layers each slowed by their measured factors when run together (lag1: the factor applied to the whole step)
staged: one graph launch + sync per attention layer added (the step graph is split for the host sync)
new KV written back GPU -> host each step (writeback_ms, the other PCIe direction) is not added
steps beyond the longest context are priced in the last bucket (steps_beyond_last_bucket)
gate_h4 valid only with all sequences, no extrapolated fetch sizes and calibration within h4.gate.calibration_tol
